newsitem.title: CHINA: HK manufacturing employment falls 11.1 pct in Mar.
newsitem.headline: HK manufacturing employment falls 11.1 pct in Mar.

text.p: Employment in Hong Kong's manufacturing sector fell 11.1 percent in March from a year earlier, the Census and Statistics Department said on Friday.
Employment in wholesale, retail, import and export trades, restaurants and hotels rose 1.9 percent during the same period.
In the finance, insurance, real estate and business services sector, employment was up 7.6 percent while employment on construction sites was up 21.4 percent.
Employment in transport, storage and communications rose 3.9 percent, while there was a 7.0 percent rise in the community, social and personal services sector.
The number of vacancies on construction sites rose 60.4 percent during the period.
